analyst.summary: Exide's core lead-acid battery business is delivering (margins and standalone PAT both up YoY in Q3/Q4 FY26 despite a sulfur cost spike met with price hikes), but the stock's ~32x P/E is really a bet on the Exide Energy Solutions (EESL) Li-ion cell plant, which remains pre-revenue, has already slipped its commercialization timeline, just changed CEOs, and is visibly dragging consolidated (vs standalone) profit. Hold: fine core, expensive optionality, no fresh Sell trigger.
